purpose: Test whether source/request/reference/prediction representation invariants and a common declared exact-match contract survive a second independently maintained official metric consumer. This is bounded post-outcome engineering validation.

selection_tradeoff.chosen: EvalScope official exact-match metric consumer against One-Eval official compute_exact_match, consuming the same two exposed source-typed captures under an explicitly shared trim-plus-strict-equality contract.
selection_tradeoff.benefit: Independent scoring implementation without new inference, expanded benchmarks, or another review of the same outputs.
selection_tradeoff.cost: Only two previously exposed questions, known expected outcomes, and two implementation families. It cannot establish generalization, official MixEval accuracy, native EvalScope generation correctness, or provider transport compatibility.
selection_tradeoff.reason_common_strict_contract: One-Eval default normalize_text includes answer-marker extraction and other transformations. Different default normalization rules are different constructs. Strict equality after separately declared whitespace trimming isolates representation/alias transport and avoids calling those expected semantic differences defects.
selection_tradeoff.fallback: No alternative framework or replacement cases if EvalScope cannot provide the frozen contract. Mark UNSUPPORTED_COMPARATOR and stop. Any broader normalization study requires a separately versioned protocol.

official_source_universe.acquisition_policy: No dataset acquisition: use only authenticated existing selected2.json and two original source_typed HTTP/result pairs. Dataset URI/revision identify original provenance and are not an instruction to re-download.
official_source_universe.sampling_rule: All and only the already selected source_index 40 and 200, in increasing numeric order. Both source_typed captures, no replacement or outcome-based exclusions.

one_eval.boundary: Official registered metric function; not a new run through native MetricRunner or HTTP client.

dataflow.required_for: Only if full One-Eval declared installation requires it; no DataFlow generation invocation.

evalscope.selection_rule: First successful source-only git ls-remote --symref on official repository HEAD after this protocol; use that exact advertised HEAD commit. Record UTC, raw response, symbolic branch and full commit before checkout. Do not choose a revision based on replay output.
evalscope.source_only_capability_question: At the pinned revision, which official deterministic exact-match callable permits case-sensitive identity comparison with normalization/extraction disabled? Can it consume a single string reference without model/judge imports or downloads?
evalscope.path_selection_rule: Use official registered exact-match callable with exact-match name, not benchmark-specific answer extraction. Resolve its source, registry/config, transitive imports and package metadata only. If ambiguous or identity semantics unavailable, stop UNSUPPORTED_COMPARATOR. Do not invent an API or substitute a hand-written equality scorer.
evalscope.reference_list_orchestration: If native metric supports list[str] aliases with any-reference semantics, use it. Otherwise invoke that same official scalar-reference metric once per alias and take numeric max; record every alias score and this reduction. No reference-based prediction extraction.

implementation_pins.independence_rule: Use separate processes/environments. Adapters independently read immutable existing source/request/response files; no gateway report, gateway normalized row, One-Eval parse_value, normalize_text, checker result or expected score is supplied to EvalScope. A common manifest may supply only paths, source IDs, hashes and declared schema. A cross-result reducer never computes replacement metric scores.

source.options: original source metadata only, including [None-string]; never treated as displayed answer choices
source.target: nonempty JSON list of nonempty strings; all aliases retained in order
source.id: original value/type retained; delivered dtype conversion accepted only when exact str roundtrip preserves value

request.messages: one user string in the captured payload; original other messages retained
request.source_binding: Question and context equal frozen source strings at their declared template positions. Literal braces around those inserted values are preserved in the original captured template; do not reject solely because braces are present. No appended A. None carrier. Validate complete captured body hash rather than a substring-only claim.
request.request_role: Already observed request validation; no new construction by EvalScope and no new HTTP transport.

supported_types.reference: Exact original target list; source anchor never taken from delivered target. Copy all aliases. Reject changed, flattened, stringified, or truncated reference lists before metric invocation.
supported_types.response: HTTP200, original response ID, declared original model qwen3.8-27b, no error, exactly one choice index0, finish_reason stop, message.content nonempty str and valid original usage per native_probe contract. reasoning_content may coexist and is preserved as separate metadata.
supported_types.prediction_view: Only choices[0].message.content, copied verbatim and hashed before normalization. generated_ans and reasoning_content are retained separately and never searched for gold or merged into the declared final view.

metric_contract.name: trimmed_case_sensitive_alias_exact_match_v1
metric_contract.canonicalization: Apply Python str.strip() independently to prediction and each source alias; no Unicode normalization, case conversion, punctuation/article removal, answer-marker extraction, containment, fuzzy match, or semantic equivalence. Retain pre/post hashes and strings.
metric_contract.score: 1 iff canonical prediction equals at least one canonical alias under the official consumer; else0. Exact original full alias list retained even if duplicate aliases normalize identically.
metric_contract.reporting: Diagnostic consumer agreement only. Separate from original default One-Eval normalized exact_match and official MixEval RULE/model-judge endpoints.

unsupported_handling.policy: Emit explicit status and retain planned unit; never turn unsupported, incomplete, or unknown into score0/model error. Unsupported controls are not false alerts. A predeclared supported healthy case rejected by the checker is a false alert even if the checker calls it unsupported. Integrity-failing cases cannot silently be excluded from counts.

healthy_metamorphic_controls.rule: For each of2source cases, independently add empty reasoning_content and add nonempty reasoning_content containing a wrong answer to a copy while preserving raw content/target/request; both remain eligible and metric score1. Synthetic provenance is explicit.
healthy_metamorphic_controls.denominator: 4 constructed healthy views; report separately from2naturalhealthyviews.
healthy_metamorphic_controls.false_alert_definition: Any rejection of these four declared supported healthy mutations, or any score change induced by reasoning-only content.

independent_units_and_denominators.dependence: Views, aliases, metric invocations and mutations are repeated transformations within two source cases; they are not additional questions, new responses, independent model experiments or benchmark samples. Do not report confidence intervals, prevalence or significance.

falsification_and_decisions.claim: Final-view transport does not need inference to repair
falsification_and_decisions.refuted_by: Either consumer disagrees with the other or expected alias match on an authenticated supported healthy final view under the exact shared contract. Preserve mismatch and inspect one targeted code question; do not rewrite contract after outcome.

falsification_and_decisions.claim: Source anchoring catches representation faults without rejecting supported healthy inputs
falsification_and_decisions.refuted_by: Any healthy real false alert, missed natural wrapper mismatch, missed injected source/reference/prediction mismatch, or promotion of length capture to known.

falsification_and_decisions.claim: Reasoning metadata is irrelevant to final-view score
falsification_and_decisions.refuted_by: Any score/status change in synthetic healthy reasoning-only controls.

falsification_and_decisions.not_supported_if: EvalScope source/API cannot instantiate the predeclared identity metric, imports One-Eval parsing/scoring, or only a copied custom scorer executes. Report blocked/unsupported rather than success.
